room.active_rule: top-K by S_i desc, K = floor(q*N + 0.5); tie-break Gaussian ID ascending (stable sort)
room.normalization: per (camera, group): ||g_i^group|| / median_nonzero(||g_i^group||), squared, summed over the 8 cluster cameras and 6 groups (means/scale/quat/opacity/SH0/SHN)
